import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int N;
    static List<String> mat;
    static List<String> mat2;
    static List<List<Integer>> v1;

    static void ff(int x, int y, List<List<Integer>> v) {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(x * N + y);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            x = cur / N;
            y = cur % N;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i];
                int ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || v.get(nx).get(ny) != -1 || mat.get(nx).charAt(ny) == 'Y')
                    continue;
                if (Character.isDigit(mat2.get(nx).charAt(ny)) && mat2.get(nx).charAt(ny) != '0' && 
                    (v.get(x).get(y) + 1 <= v1.get(nx).get(ny) || v1.get(nx).get(ny) == -1)) {
                    v.set(nx, new ArrayList<>(v.get(nx)));
                    v.get(nx).set(ny, v.get(x).get(y) + 1);
                    if (v.get(nx).get(ny) != v1.get(nx).get(ny))
                        q.offer(nx * N + ny);
                } else if (v1.get(nx).get(ny) == -1 || v1.get(nx).get(ny) > v.get(x).get(y) + 1) {
                    v.set(nx, new ArrayList<>(v.get(nx)));
                    v.get(nx).set(ny, v.get(x).get(y) + 1);
                    q.offer(nx * N + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void ini(int x, int y, List<List<Integer>> v) {
        v.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                row.add(-1);
            }
            v.add(row);
        }
        v.get(x).set(y, 0);
        ff(x, y, v);
    }

    static void get(List<String> m, List<List<List<Integer>>> v) {
        v.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            v.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(m.get(i).charAt(j)) && m.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    List<List<Integer>> temp = new ArrayList<>();
                    ini(i, j, temp);
                    v.set(i * N + j, temp);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, cost, flow;
        Edge(int f, int t, int c, int fl) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            cost = c;
            flow = fl;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int Nodes;
        List<Integer> dist, flow, parent;
        List<Edge> edges;
        int total_cost, total_flow;

        void clear(int n) {
            Nodes = n;
            dist = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, INF));
            flow = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, 0));
            parent = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, 0));
        }

        void add_edge(int from, int to, int cost, int flow) {
            edges.add(new Edge(from, to, cost, flow));
            edges.add(new Edge(to, from, -cost, 0));
        }

        void bellman_ford(int src, int sink) {
            clear(Nodes);
            flow.set(src, INF);
            dist.set(src, 0);
            boolean updated;
            for (int iter = 0; iter < Nodes; iter++) {
                updated = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(i);
                    if (e.flow > 0 && dist.get(e.to) > dist.get(e.from) + e.cost) {
                        dist.set(e.to, dist.get(e.from) + e.cost);
                        flow.set(e.to, Math.min(flow.get(e.from), e.flow));
                        parent.set(e.to, i);
                        updated = true;
                    }
                }
                if (!updated) break;
            }
        }

        void compute_min_cost_flow(int src, int sink) {
            if (src == sink) {
                total_cost = 0;
                total_flow = INF;
                return;
            }
            total_cost = 0;
            total_flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                bellman_ford(src, sink);
                if (flow.get(sink) == 0) break;
                for (int cur = sink; cur != src; cur = edges.get(parent.get(cur)).from) {
                    int rev_idx = parent.get(cur) % 2 == 1 ? parent.get(cur) - 1 : parent.get(cur) + 1;
                    Edge e = edges.get(parent.get(cur));
                    e.flow -= flow.get(sink);
                    edges.get(rev_idx).flow += flow.get(sink);
                    total_cost += e.cost * flow.get(sink);
                }
                total_flow += flow.get(sink);
            }
        }
    }

    static final int IN(int a) { return 2 * a; }
    static final int OUT(int a) { return 2 * a + 1; }

    static MinCostMaxFlow mcf = new MinCostMaxFlow();

    static void add_edge(int i, int j, int x, int y) {
        int n1 = i * N + j;
        int n2 = x * N + y + N * N;
        mcf.add_edge(OUT(n1), IN(n2), 0, 1000000);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        List<String> a = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> b = new ArrayList<>();
        N = n;
        int si = -1, sj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a.add(sc.next());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a.get(i).charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    si = i;
                    sj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        mat = a;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b.add(sc.next());
        }
        mat2 = b;
        List<List<Integer>> v = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<List<Integer>>> vv = new ArrayList<>();
        v1 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                row.add(INF);
            }
            v1.add(row);
        }
        ini(si, sj, v);
        v1 = v;
        get(a, vv);
        mcf.clear(4 * N * N + 2);
        int src = 4 * N * N;
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            mcf.add_edge(src, IN(i), 0, 1000000);
            mcf.add_edge(OUT(N * N + i), src + 1, 0, 1000000);
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a.get(x).charAt(y))) {
                    int k = x * N + y;
                    mcf.add_edge(IN(k), OUT(k), 0, a.get(x).charAt(y) - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(b.get(x).charAt(y))) {
                    int k = x * N + y + N * N;
                    mcf.add_edge(IN(k), OUT(k), 0, b.get(x).charAt(y) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b.get(i).charAt(j)) && b.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < vv.size(); k++) {
                        if (!vv.get(k).isEmpty()) {
                            int x = k / N;
                            int y = k % N;
                            if (vv.get(k).get(i).get(j) == -1 || vv.get(k).get(i).get(j) > t) continue;
                            add_edge(x, y, i, j);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        mcf.compute_min_cost_flow(src, src + 1);
        System.out.println(mcf.total_flow);
    }
}
